title: Jonik Cannon
description: A three-frame portrait of the photographer in a dark suit and tie, shot against the pale angled walls of a gallery interior.

title: Earth from space
description: The blue curve of Earth with the moon above it and the sun flaring past the limb, against a dense starfield.

title: In the green hills
description: The photographer in aviator sunglasses, close to camera, with cleared farmland and low green mountains stretching out behind under a heavy grey sky.

title: Red-bellied woodpecker
description: A red-bellied woodpecker gripping a bare winter branch, its barred black-and-white back and scarlet crown bright against the tangle of grey twigs.

title: Two turtles
description: A pair of pond turtles drifting through murky green water, shells patterned in amber and olive, ripples spreading around them.

title: Full moon
description: A full moon isolated against an entirely black sky, craters and maria picked out in soft grey.

title: Armadillo foraging
description: A nine-banded armadillo nosing through dry leaf litter at the edge of green undergrowth, its banded shell and tail catching the light.

title: Full moon close up
description: A tighter frame on the full moon, its seas and crater fields clearly separated across the disc.

title: Capuchin on the shoulder
description: A capuchin monkey perched on the photographer's shoulder on a palm-lined beach, both looking toward the camera under a hard blue sky.

title: Capuchin and palms
description: A capuchin monkey reaching up from the photographer's arm, leaning palms and turquoise surf filling the background.

title: Poolside lantern
description: A glowing dome lantern on a dark deck at night, palm fronds lit behind it and a bottle standing on the boards alongside.
